about.intro: FursadHub bridges students, organizations and universities through real internship workflows that support learning and career development.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.body: Connect students with real opportunities, organizations with emerging talent, and universities with clearer internship outcomes.

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.body: A trusted internship ecosystem where education and meaningful workplace experience work together.

reasons.organizations: Organizations need access to capable emerging talent.
reasons.platform: FursadHub connects these workflows in one platform.

organizations.title: Discover Organizations
organizations.subtitle: Explore organizations currently offering public internship opportunities.
organizations.scopeNote: This directory includes organizations represented in currently published public internships.

universities.title: Transform Internship Management
universities.subtitle: Give your university a structured way to support students from nomination through internship completion.
universities.directoryNote: A public university directory is not currently exposed by the platform API.

students.title: Student Management
students.body: Manage enrolled students and department membership.

nominations.title: Student Nominations
nominations.body: Nominate eligible students for university-targeted opportunities.

placements.title: Placement Tracking
placements.body: Follow placements from offer acceptance through completion.

supervision.title: Academic Supervision
supervision.body: Assign supervisors and review internship progress.

policies.title: Internship Policies
policies.body: Configure the academic requirements used for completion.

verification.title: Verified Institution
verification.body: Build trust through the platform verification workflow.

hero.description: FursadHub connects students with internship opportunities, organizations with talented young professionals, and universities with real-world career experiences.

ecosystem.title: How FursadHub Works
ecosystem.subtitle: One platform for students, organizations and universities

student.title: For Students
student.body: Discover published internships, apply through supported pathways and follow your placement through completion.

organization.title: For Organizations
organization.body: Publish opportunities, review candidates and manage workplace placement responsibilities.

university.title: For Universities
university.body: Support student nominations and oversee academic internship requirements and supervision.

landing.subhead: FursadHub connects students, universities and organizations around one internship pipeline — from first application to final defense.

student.title: For students
student.body: Find and apply to verified internships with organizations and universities across Somalia.

organization.title: For organizations
organization.body: Source and recruit students from verified universities, then manage the whole placement.

university.title: For universities
university.body: Oversee your students' internships from nomination through to their final defense.

sourcing.title: Post or discover
sourcing.body: Organizations publish opportunities; students apply directly or are nominated by their university.

recruitment.title: Get matched
recruitment.body: Public applications and university nominations feed one candidate pipeline through to an offer.

placement.title: Placement to completion
placement.body: Weekly logs, attendance, supervision and evaluation carry the internship through to its defense.

landing.trustLine: Built for Somalia's universities, organizations and students.

lifecycle.title: One pipeline, start to finish
lifecycle.body: A placement doesn't end at the offer. FursadHub carries it through weekly logs, attendance, supervision from both sides, evaluation and a final defense — so universities and organizations can see real progress, not just a hire date.

cta.title: Ready to get started?
cta.body: Registration is free during the pilot — create an account as a student, organization, or university.

footer.description: One internship pipeline for Somalia's students, universities and organizations — from first application to final defense.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.description: The page you're looking for doesn't exist or may have moved.
